decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height:normal">The maximum luminance of the sign shall not exceed the values recommended in the Institution of Lighting Engineers' Technical Report No. 5 (third edition).</span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any road traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air, or so as otherwise to render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway or aerodrome (civil or military).</span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">All illumination shall be non-intermittent (including display of animation and video) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Where an advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.</span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.</span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Where an advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.</span><br></p>
description: Replacement and re-location of existing paper and paste advertising hoarding with a 3m x 6m internally illuminated digital advertising screen (D-Poster)
